messages.author: 89c04f2e40dabf01
messages.subject: Vary Max Memory Size
parts:
Is there any inadvertent negative effects that could arise by allowing memory.limit() to be used as I have below instead of hard coding in some predetermined number as in the second example?

options(shiny.maxRequestSize=memory.limit()*1024^2) # let memory limit be determined from machine

options(shiny.maxRequestSize=300*1024^2) # Force a 300 mg limit on file upload

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Vary Max Memory Size
parts: The request body is actually buffered to disk, not held in RAM, so I don't think you even really need to consider the memory limit when determining the max request size. The low default limit is mostly there to make it harder for a malicious client to fill up your hard drive (or your server's hard drive) or something like that.
